svg.title: Animated abstract representation of generative AI, warm palette
svg.desc: A field of scattered dots on the left drifts and jitters like noise, faint lines in the middle zone repeatedly draw themselves in and fade as loose clusters form, an ordered lattice of connected nodes on the right pulses in a wave sweeping left to right, and two gradient threads with moving dashes flow from the chaotic field into the ordered grid, all in a warm terracotta and coral palette.
